name: Orbital superiority
description: A gameplay change (off by default; set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page). During a ground invasion it matters who holds the orbit above the planet (the armed ships and bases of each side within 2000 of it, the original game's Space Control measure). Attackers clearly stronger: their Space Control bonus is +50% instead of +25%. Contested: the invaders get no bonus, -35% attack rising to -50% the longer it lasts, and lose a little strength every day (supply lines disrupted). Defenders clearly stronger: invaders -50% attack, heavier daily losses and no further landings there (supply lines cut). AI empires weigh it: they invade where they can hold the orbit, keep their fleet over the planet, keep their troops aboard until the orbit is theirs, send relief fleets to their invaded colonies, and pull back from fights they cannot win.

params.name: orbitalSuperiorityRatio
params.label: A side holds the orbit when its space strength is at least this many times the other's

params.name: orbitalSuperiorityAttackerBonus

params.name: orbitalContestedAttritionPct

params.name: orbitalAttritionMinReadiness
